About Us
The biggest adventure you can take, is to live the life of your dreams
For us, that adventure began when we, Rodney and Elzabé, traded city life for the bushveld
and built Thorn Tree Bush Camp inside the Dinokeng Big Five Game Reserve. What started in
2016 with a single cottage and a dream has grown into a camp where guests can feel the same
magic that first captured our hearts: the deep roar of lions at night, the chatter of hornbills
at dawn, and sunsets that splash the sky with colours no photograph can truly capture.
We are passionate campers ourselves — often exploring South Africa with our Conqueror trailer,
gathering new ideas around every campfire to bring back home. Those adventures shape Thorn Tree,
ensuring our tented bush camps, cosy cabins, and self-catering cottage aren't just places to
stay, but places to experience. Each site offers privacy, a touch of comfort, and a connection
to the wild.
Here, evenings mean crackling fires and braais under the stars, mornings mean giraffes
strolling the fence line, and afternoons might just end with a soak in a Tickel Tub hot tub.
Whether you're here to spot the Big Five, listen to the night sounds of hyena and jackal, or
simply escape the rush of city life, we hope you'll leave with more than just memories — we
hope you'll leave with your own Thorn Tree story.
🏡 Accommodation
Sleep under stars, wake to lion calls - bushveld comfort awaits.
Escape the bustle and step into the bushveld. At Thorn Tree Bush Camp, each cottage,
tent, or campsite offers privacy, crackling fires under star-filled skies, and the
chance to fall asleep to the night sounds of lion, hyena, and jackal. This is camping
and comfort woven into one unforgettable bush experience.
Fully Equipped Tents Caravan/Trailer Stands
🦁 Safaris
Track the Big Five and more with expert guides by your side.
Set out into the Dinokeng Big Five Game Reserve on an open game vehicle or guided bush walk.
Our passionate field guides share their knowledge of the land, its animals, and hidden
details — from tracks in the dust to the calls of birds. Every safari is a story waiting
to be told.
Read More
⛺ Wilderness Camping
Unfenced, untamed, and unforgettable – true Big Five camping in the wild.
For seasoned adventurers, our unfenced wilderness stands offer the rawest way
to experience the bush. Camp in Big Five territory with nothing but canvas and
campfire between you and the wild — no frills, just freedom.
Wilderness Stands

Accommodation
Minimum stay is 2 nights over normal weekends, and 3 or 4 nights over long weekends
No day visitors
No loud noise allowed
Serviced during the week on request, no service over weekends except on special request
For more information, check our accommodation terms .
Camp Layout Policies Indemnity Rules
Welcome to Your Bushveld Escape
Whether you're looking for a romantic hideaway, a family adventure, or a true wilderness
experience, Thorn Tree Bush Camp has the perfect spot. From luxury tented accommodation
and self-catering cabins to private bush campsites and unfenced Big Five wilderness stands,
each stay offers privacy, comfort, and the magic of the bush.
Tented Accommodation Campsites Off-grid Wilderness Camps
Paperbark Cottage – Private Bushveld Retreat | Sleeps 2
A charming and private self-catering cottage for two, tucked away amongst the trees for a peaceful and relaxed bushveld escape.
Paperbark Cottage features a comfortable queen-size bed, an en-suite bathroom with both bath and shower, and a fully equipped private kitchen with everything you need for an easy self-catering stay.
Outside, enjoy your own private braai area surrounded by the sights and sounds of the bush, or light the fire and unwind in your wood-fired “Tickle Tub” hot tub — perfect for relaxing beneath the stars.
Private, peaceful and full of bushveld charm — a cosy retreat for two where you can simply slow down and unwind.
Elephant Root – Couples Bushveld Safari Escape | Sleeps 2
A private and romantic bushveld safari escape for two, combining the charm of canvas with modern comfort.
Elephant Root features a comfortable queen-size bed and a spacious en-suite bathroom, where you can relax in the bath with a view across the bush or enjoy the experience of your own open-air shower surrounded by nature.
A private kitchenette includes a bar fridge, two-plate gas hob and air fryer for easy, relaxed self-catering.
Outside, enjoy your own private braai area or unwind in your wood-fired “Tickle Tub” hot tub, surrounded by the sights and sounds of the bushveld —perfect for a peaceful soak beneath the stars.
Private, romantic and comfortably secluded — your own little safari escape in the bush-veld
Fever Tree – Family Bush Cabin | Sleeps 2 Adults + 2 Children
A private and cosy family cabin tucked away in the bush, ideal for 2 adults and up to 2 children looking for an easy, relaxed bushveld escape with their own private facilities.
Inside, the cabin features a comfortable double bed for the adults and a sleeper couch for the children, together with an en-suite bathroom with shower and toilet. A convenient private kitchenette with fridge and cooking facilities makes simple self-catering easy, while bedding and bath towels are provided.
Outside, enjoy your own private braai area and patio, surrounded by the sights and sounds of the bush.
The highlight is your own wood-fired Tickle Tub hot tub overlooking the bush — light the fire, heat the water and settle in for a relaxing soak beneath the stars.
Private, cosy and family-friendly a comfortable little bush-veld hideaway made for slowing down and spending time together.
Umbrella Thorn – Family Safari Tent | Sleeps 2 Adults + 3 Children
A spacious and relaxed family safari tent, designed specifically for 2 adults and up to 3 children wanting to enjoy a real bush-veld camping experience with the comfort of their own private facilities.
The large safari tent features a king-size bed for the adults, which can be converted into twin beds, together with a bunk bed and additional comfortable stretcher bed for the children.
One of Umbrella Thorns special features is its private open-air en-suite bathroom, with shower, toilet and basin — giving your family the convenience of your own ablution while still enjoying the sights and sounds of the bush.
Outside, a fully equipped private gazebo kitchen and dining area provides plenty of space for preparing meals and spending time together.
Your own private boma and braai area is perfect for relaxed family evenings around the fire, meals under the stars and quiet mornings surrounded by the bushveld.
Spacious, private and made for families — a relaxed bush-veld escape where time together comes naturally.
Weeping Boerbean – Family Bush Cabin | Sleeps 2 Adults + 2 Children
Tucked away in a quiet corner of the bush, Weeping Boer-bean is a cosy family cabin offering a comfortable escape with a relaxed, rustic bushveld feel.
The cabin features a queen-size bed, sleeper couch, and children’s bunk, making it ideal for a couple or small family.
A convenient kitchenette with fridge and gas hob provides everything needed for simple self-catering, while bedding and bath towels are provided for an easy stay.
A Private Ablution with shower, toilet and basin is located a short walk from the cabin, approximately 15–20 meters away. It is exclusively for Weeping Boer-bean guests but is not en-suite.
Outside, enjoy your own private braai area, boma and fireplace, where you can settle in around the fire and take in the peaceful views across the northern bushveld.
Cosy, private and comfortably rustic a relaxed family escape with just the right touch of the wild.
Sickle Bush Rooftop Tent | Sleeps 2
A unique elevated camping experience for adventurous couples looking for something a little different in the bushveld.
Climb the ladder to your cosy rooftop tent, set on a raised platform amongst the trees. Inside, a comfortable double bed with bedding provided offers a peaceful place to fall asleep to the sounds of the bush and wake to the morning bird calls.
Below the tent, you’ll have your own private shaded dining and relaxation area, together with a kitchenette equipped with a fridge and gas hob. Your private braai and fire-pit area completes the bush-camping experience — perfect for relaxed evenings around the fire beneath the stars.
